title: Glad Was My Heart to Hear
description: Glad Was My Heart to Hear in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: James Montgomery wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 19 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Delight of Worship”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Glad was my heart to hear My old com-pan-ions say Come, in the house of God ap-pear, For 'tis a ho-ly day.

lines: Glad was my heart to hear
Come, in the house of God appear,
While young and old in many a band
Oft as they meet for worship here,

licence: Public domain: James Montgomery died in 1854.
credits: Words by James Montgomery (1771–1854), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to FRANCONIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
